verdict.rationale: Fern's docs include a Web Analytics tab that reports llms.txt usage with traffic broken out by LLM provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.). This separates AI-agent readership from ordinary web traffic and attributes it to specific agents. Reader activity can also be queried through Fern's MCP server. Missing for 10: evidence that agent detection covers all page and .md fetches rather than only llms.txt, an explicit side-by-side human-vs-agent comparison view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
